items.title: Account Manager - Brazil
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customization to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments. You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale. In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment. What you bring - 5+ years of Customer Success or Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in Brazil - Fluent in Portuguese and English - Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents - Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs - Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities - Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization - Strong understanding of the LATAM market landscape and cultural nuances - Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: Join Novibet as a VIP Account Manager (Cyprus)! Are you ready to take on a key role in a dynamic, fast-growing company? If you have a passion for Account Management and thrive in a fast-paced environment , this could be the right opportunity for you. We are committed to staying at the forefront of technological advancements, continually pushing boundaries and delivering seamless entertainment and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base. Why Novibet At Novibet, you are empowered to excel, prioritising growth through listening and learning as part of a group of forward-thinkers and doers continuously adapting to new challenges. We are equally committed to fostering a positive, inclusive, and supportive workplace culture that empowers every individual to thrive. Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,400 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. What we are looking for As a VIP Account Manager at Novibet , you will be responsible for managing key accounts, maintaining long-term relationships, and maximizing sales opportunities within them. What you will work on Manage a portfolio of VIP Key Account Customers Acquire a thorough understanding of key customer needs and requirements Expand the relationships with existing customers by continuously proposing solutions that meet their objectives Play an integral part in generating new sales that will turn into long-lasting relationships Provide assistance to high-end, high-value players and attending to hospitality events Work closely with internal teams, in order to serve high-value customers and provide a VIP customer experience Prepare regular reports of progress and forecasts to internal stakeholders using key account metrics What you bring Diploma/Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration or a related field will be considered as a plus Proven experience as a VIP Account Manager in the iGaming industry Strong communication and interpersonal skills with an aptitude for building relationships with professionals of all organizational levels Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office Understanding of CRM tools Ability in problem-solving and negotiation Fluency in English What we offer We truly value our people at Novibet! items.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations
items.location_text: Chicago, IL; Clearwater, FL; Westlake, TX
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. TradePMR is Robinhood's custody and technology platform for registered investment advisors (RIAs). Our integration ecosystem spans core technology partners, specialized workflow and TAMP partners, and a broader network of consultants, recruiters, and capital providers. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, Business Development, and the tactical integrations team. It's a collaborative group focused on advisor success and on building partnerships that last! The Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships & Integrations owns TradePMR's external-facing relationships with technology partners and advisor firms across the integration ecosystem. The tactical integrations team handles vendor onboarding, data feeds, and technical implementation. You'll decide which partnerships matter most and who we should build them with. You'll advise enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams, host partner events, negotiate special agreements, and equip our sales teams with accurate partner collateral. You'll also bring partner and client insight into integration roadmap discussions, shaping priorities through influence and input rather than build ownership. This is a business and partnerships role, not a product or engineering role, and your impact will show up in the strength of our advisor and partner relationships! This role is based in our Clearwater, FL, Chicago IL, and Westlake, TX office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Serve as a direct advisor to enterprise RIAs and breakaway teams evaluating custody transitions and platform fit Own and run Transition Sandbox walkthroughs, live demo environments for prospective and transitioning firms Act as a trusted point of contact for advisor firms navigating the TradePMR integration ecosystem Build and maintain the Partner Resource Hub, including custodial comparison sheets, integration guides, and platform one-pagers Equip Practice Management and Sales with current, accurate partner and integration collateral, and keep internal teams informed of live and upcoming integrations Own and execute the Center of Influence (COI) engagement cadence, including monthly strategy touchpoints, quarterly briefings, and virtual executive roundtables Stand up and run the COI Advisory Council, spanning consulting, technology, M&A, and recruiting Directly own relationships with core technology partners and specialized workflow and TAMP partners Coordinate with Marketing and Business Development on adjacent COI relationships, such as transition consultants, M&A advisors, capital providers, breakaway recruiters, and compliance consultants Plan and represent TradePMR at flagship partner events, and own regional VIP dinners and executive roundtables, including guest lists, briefing content, and follow-up Negotiate custom commercial terms with strategic partners, such as portfolio-wide custodial fee schedules, custom API reporting SLAs, and enterprise onboarding SLAs Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on sign-off for non-standard agreements, using a template-first approach and escalating to custom terms only where justified Surface partner and client integration requests and pain points into Product and Engineering prioritization discussions Represent the external partner and advisor-firm perspective in integration roadmap planning, and work with the tactical integrations team so strategic priorities turn into executed integrations What you bring 7+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic account management, ideally in wealthtech, fintech, or RIA custodial and technology services Demonstrated experience managing external relationships with technology vendors and/or advisor or client firms in a regulated financial services environment Comfort serving as a primary external face for the organization, including event hosting, executive-level relationship management, and negotiation Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, Marketing, and technical integrations teams Familiarity with the RIA custodial technology landscape (portfolio management systems, CRM, TAMP, and financial planning tools) is a plus What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $179,000 — $210,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $157,000 — $185,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $139,000 — $164,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Middle Live Account Manager
items.description: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people . With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a skilled and highly driven Middle Live Account Manager on Malta! About the job: EM Live is seeking a commercially minded Account Manager to build strong customer relationships and help partners maximise the value of our live casino offering. This is a mid-level role for someone who understands the live gaming provider landscape, takes ownership, and is motivated to grow accounts through insight, responsiveness, and consistent execution. The successful candidate will combine at least three years of relevant industry experience with a hungry, proactive mindset. They will be confident working with customers and internal teams, curious about the product and market, and willing to keep learning as EM Live grows. Key Responsibilities: Own and develop a portfolio of EM Live customers, acting as their primary commercial contact. Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and maintain a clear understanding of their objectives, priorities, and challenges. Create and execute account plans that support retention, revenue growth, product adoption, and long-term partnership value. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across EM Live products, tables, markets, and promotional initiatives. Monitor account performance, player and market trends, and key commercial indicators; turn insights into clear customer recommendations. Lead regular business reviews and provide accurate updates on performance, opportunities, risks, and agreed actions. Coordinate effectively with commercial, product, operations, marketing, and technical teams to deliver for customers. Work with customers to optimise EM Live site positioning, visibility, and placement across casino lobbies and relevant promotional areas. Plan, coordinate, and evaluate customer promotions that drive awareness, engagement, and commercial performance. Support launches, integrations, and new-market activity, ensuring stakeholders remain informed and aligned. Maintain accurate account records, commercial forecasts, opportunities, and next steps in the relevant systems. Stay informed about the live casino market, competitor activity, and emerging customer needs. Requirements: At least three years of account management, commercial, or partner-facing experience with a live gaming provider. Practical understanding of live casino products, operator needs, commercial models, and the wider online gaming ecosystem. Demonstrated ability to manage customer relationships, prioritise competing demands, and follow through on commitments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to lead customer meetings and business reviews. Commercial awareness and comfort using performance data to identify opportunities and recommend actions. Collaborative working style and the ability to influence internal stakeholders without direct authority. Strong organisation, attention to detail, and a disciplined approach to forecasting and account planning. Demonstrated experience and practical knowledge of site positioning, including optimising live casino visibility and placement within operator lobbies. Hands-on experience planning, running, and reviewing customer promotions that support engagement and revenue growth. Desirable : Experience supporting live casino launches, integrations, dedicated tables, or branded environments. Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or customer segments. Turkish language skills are preferred. What Success Looks Like : Hungry: actively looks for opportunities, asks the right questions, and is not satisfied with simply maintaining the status quo. Motivated: takes ownership of outcomes, follows through, and brings energy and resilience to customer challenges. Willing to learn: seeks feedback, builds product and market knowledge quickly, and adapts as the business evolves. Customer-focused: listens carefully, communicates clearly, and balances customer needs with sustainable commercial outcomes. Collaborative: works constructively across teams and shares information early to keep delivery on track. Here's what we offer: Start with a competitive number of annual leave days, increasing as you grow with us. Private Medical Subscription. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Access to online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Gym membership. Meal allowance. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Business Development Lead - US
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? This role decides where KICK’s next revenue comes from. As our Business Development Lead in the US, you’ll win new agency groups, verticals and enterprise clients, and shape the offers that win them. What you’ll build with us: We are looking for a Business Development Lead to grow KICK's advertising business in the US. You will find and win clients that are new to KICK, make the case for advertising on the platform, and close the first deals that become long-term partnerships. This is a full-time opportunity based in New York. You’ll work from home, but you won’t be working alone. You’ll be out in the market with agencies and advertisers, working closely with our US commercial team and connected to our Australian and Serbian teams as we build KICK’s US presence together. Who is Easygo and KICK? Easygo is a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands, including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. These brands have a fierce global following, but our crew is employed directly by Easygo, and that’s where the real fun happens. KICK is our live streaming platform, built to put creators and their communities first. It gives content creators 95% of their streaming income and has redefined what a live streaming platform can be. KICK started as a disruptor challenging the status quo. Since launching in 2022, it has grown to more than 100 million accounts, and 81.7% of its audience is aged 18 to 34. Creators stream on KICK across gaming, talk shows, podcasts, IRL, sport and events. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast, and who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact, and that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Win and onboard new agency groups, vertical offerings and enterprise clients against the US net new number Own the new business pipeline and forecast, from prospect to close Work on cross-functional projects that take new offerings to market. Build launch packages for new verticals and events, and decide which markets and clients we go after first Feed what new clients need into the product roadmap Mentor junior team members and set the standard for how KICK wins new business Your track record: 9+ years in partnerships, programmatic supply or platform business development A record of winning new agency groups, verticals or enterprise clients against a net new revenue number An established network across US agency groups and enterprise advertisers Experience pricing and packaging new ad products, and turning client feedback into product requirements Working knowledge of programmatic (PMPs, programmatic guaranteed, and DSP and SSP mechanics) Familiarity with CRM and order management systems (Boostr is a plus) Strong negotiation and presentation skills, including with C-level and senior agency stakeholders Bonus points if you also have: Experience with creator networks, live streaming, entertainment or gaming platforms Experience selling to marketing and user acquisition teams at game studios and publishers, including rewarded campaigns Hands-on experience with programmatic supply partnerships, such as SSPs, mediation or PMP deals Experience taking a platform or ad product into a new vertical or market Here are our benefits and perks: Sharpening your edge The ultimate sandbox. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks of paid parental leave for primary carers, so you can be there for the moments that matter. Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage. Matched 401(k) contributions, so your future grows alongside your career. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge. #s-dni

items.title: Senior Sales Associate - CB Infrastructure
items.department: Institutional Sales, Trading, and Prime Services
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Sales Associate on the Coinbase Infrastructure team, you'll drive new partnership development with PSPs, fintechs, and banks looking to launch stablecoin payment products on Coinbase's platform. This team takes a consultative approach, helping partners move from strategy through integration and post-launch success across payments, trading, and agentic partnerships. You'll manage deal execution across the pipeline, build relationships with partner stakeholders, and contribute market insights that shape how Coinbase positions its infrastructure products to financial institutions. What you'll do: Originate new partnership opportunities with PSPs, fintechs, and banks by researching high-potential prospects and developing tailored outreach and engagement strategies. Manage deal execution from initial diligence through negotiation and close, coordinating across legal, compliance, and technical workstreams while delivering against revenue targets. Lead partner conversations by translating Coinbase's stablecoin infrastructure capabilities into partner-specific value propositions for senior stakeholders. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Account Management, Solutions Architecture, Legal, and Specialty Sales to support smooth partner onboarding and integration. Share market intelligence, competitive insights, and partner feedback with Product and leadership to inform Coinbase's infrastructure roadmap and positioning. Required Skills and Experience: 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, or partnerships at a PSP, fintech, bank, or crypto company, with a track record of originating and closing deals. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals from inception through close, including coordination across legal, compliance, and technical workstreams. Working knowledge of the payments and trading ecosystem, including stablecoins, cross-border payments, card networks, payment rails, and digital wallets, with the ability to translate that knowledge into client-facing recommendations. Proven ability to communicate complex technical and crypto concepts clearly and persuasively to senior and executive audiences. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $195,670 — $230,200 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Prediction Markets is a high growth market segment for Sportradar as we enable our clients to build and trade the next generation of sports markets. Sportradar is looking to bring in a seasoned seller with proven experience to execute our commercial strategy in the prediction markets ecosystem. In this role, you will be the bridge between our technology and the broader financial, sports, and data industries. You’ll own a book of new and existing accounts and work closely with cross-functional groups to help shape a new category for Sportradar. The successful candidate will report to the Vice President, Prediction Markets. THE CHALLENGE Build and manage a pipeline of Prediction Market market makers and liquidity providers, from qualifying leads to proactive outreach Lead deal processes end to end: discovery, solution design, pricing, proposals and contract negotiation Package the right mix of data products and additional services to each client’s use case Develop, maintain, and grow senior relationships with client leadership teams Contribute to the development of regional market intelligence, identifying emerging trends, governance developments, regulatory changes, competitive dynamics, and growth opportunities. Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and business forecast Represent Sportradar at industry events and client meetings ABOUT YOU 7+ years in Sales or Business Development with at least three years selling data, technology, or trading products into fintech or capital markets. A deep understanding of prediction markets, order book mechanics, and derivatives trading is highly preferred. An existing network of contacts within institutional finance, market makers, and digital assets A proven track record of closing 7-figure enterprise deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships. Ability to communicate effectively with founders, traders, product leads and executives. Disciplined pipeline management in a CRM such as Salesforce. Willingness to travel, mostly within the US OUR OFFER A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. Certain exemptions may apply depending on location — your local point of contact can provide further details. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Meet with the team and later with the Hiring Manager to dive into your solution, as also discuss team fit. Onsite Interview: Meet with the local team and take a tour of our office for a final meet-and-greet. Finals Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

items.title: VC Partnerships Manager
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced VC Partnerships Manager to join our Startups Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in managing relationships with top venture capital funds and startup accelerators, with the goal of providing exceptional support to the portfolio companies of these funds. We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups across stages with resources that help them get started with OpenAI APIs and build quickly, and provide access to OpenAI teams, community, and expertise to support their growth. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for forming and managing partnerships with top venture investors, accelerators, and other partners in the startup ecosystem, as well as working across the OpenAI organization to help startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. You’ll work cross-functionality with product, research, engineering, marketing, support, and solutions architecture to help customers get the most out of our models. This role is based in our San Francisco office. We use a hybrid work model (3 days/week in the office) and offer relocation assistance for new employees. In this role, you will: - Manage and develop a set of partner-level relationships with top venture capital funds, startup accelerator programs, and other external partners in the startup ecosystem. - Develop strategies to drive adoption of OpenAI’s models among thousands of startups and ensure companies have the resources they need to build quickly and effectively using OpenAI’s models. - Identify opportunities for 1:many engagements and events for founders, and execute in collaboration with VC firm and internal teams. - Provide technical guidance to startups in 1:1 engagements, in partnership with internal technical teams. - Represent OpenAI at startup ecosystem events and speaking engagements. - Analyze key metrics within startup portfolios and create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. - Contribute to the development of programs and strategic initiatives focused on startup customers. - Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups. - Closely monitor the industry landscape and startup landscape to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering. - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. - Support the development of company culture. We're seeking someone with experience including: - Passion for the startup ecosystem and supporting the growth of fast-growing companies. - Experience as a founder of a venture-backed startup (preferably a technical founder), a venture capital investor, or early employee at a fast-growing startup. - Technical understanding of AI technologies and AI product landscape. - 10+ years experience managing high-value external relationships (e.g., customers, partners, investors, Board of Directors) and working directly with founders and C-level executives. - Public speaking skills, and able to communicate technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. - Leading high-visibility customer engagements (e.g., conferences, 1:many events, product launches, etc.). - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. - Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. - Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. - Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. - Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: VP of Sales - Public Sector
items.location_text: Toronto, Calgary, Winnipeg, Canada, London, Vancouver, United Kingdom, Halifax, Edmonton, Ottawa, Montreal
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview As our VP of Sales - Global Public Sector, you will spearhead year-over-year global revenue growth by developing and executing on enterprise level PUBSEC customer acquisition strategies. You will drive long-term success through strategic development, coaching, and expanding Cohere’s presence in the public sector. In this pivotal leadership role, you will cultivate and guide our sales team to exceed revenue targets and organizational goals, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. Key Responsibilities As our VP of Public Sector Sales you will: - Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive, global go-to-market growth strategy and sales plan for the Public Sector, driving revenue growth and market expansion working with other regional sales teams. - Provide sales and operational leadership to Cohere’s PUBSEC sales team, ensuring alignment with company objectives and priorities. - Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to synchronize sales efforts with broader company goals. - Represent Cohere at PUBSEC industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities, as well as with regulators and government agencies, in collaboration with other regional and global leaders in Cohere. - Manage and nurture relationships with government decision-makers and partners to ensure Cohere’s success in the region. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiating and closing high-value deals. - Collaborate with global teams to strengthen anchor relationships and establish best practices for enterprise-level project implementations, ensuring strong client engagement throughout project lifecycles. Qualifications This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you: - Have 10+ years of PUBSEC sales and leadership experience leading go-to-market efforts and driving revenue growth for fast paced technology organizations. - Have an established network, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations with an emphasis on the Defense and Intelligence communities. - Possess a proven track record of leading capture and sales efforts for consultative solution sales and business development efforts, with a deep understanding of regional procurement and budget cycles, customer success, and resource allocation. - Have exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build cross-functional relationships and influence at all levels. - Are comfortable operating in a matrix environment, coordinating efforts across cross-functional teams and regions without the need for a large direct organization. - Are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of working independently, rolling up sleeves, and driving impact as a ‘builder.’ - Experience in AI or a related industry is highly desirable. - Must be willing to travel (25-40%). WORKING LOCATION: This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: We are looking for a Senior Media Buyer to take full ownership of paid acquisition for an international business operating in the adult creator economy. This is a hands-on position for a performance marketing specialist who knows how to scale campaigns in restricted verticals, manage substantial advertising budgets, and optimize traffic based on actual customer revenue. Responsibilities - Take ownership of paid traffic acquisition, with Meta as the primary advertising platform, while developing additional acquisition channels through Google Ads, native advertising, and adult ad networks - Plan, launch, test, and scale campaigns targeting the US, UK, and Australian markets, managing budgets and optimizing performance across the entire customer journey - Develop and improve acquisition funnels connecting advertising campaigns, landing and bridge pages, private chat interactions, and paid conversions, including subscriptions, PPV purchases, and custom content - Focus campaign optimization on commercial performance, tracking cost per chat, cost per first purchase, customer payback periods, and 30-day customer value rather than relying solely on CTR, CPM, or other top-of-funnel metrics - Establish a structured creative testing and scaling process, evaluating different concepts, defining performance thresholds, allocating test budgets, and identifying opportunities for profitable growth - Maintain stable advertising operations in restricted verticals through compliant account structures, careful budget scaling, proactive account management, and appropriate recovery procedures following restrictions or suspensions - Build and manage the tracking and attribution infrastructure, including tools such as Keitaro, server-side conversion events, and postbacks, ensuring reliable reporting and accurate campaign optimization - Collaborate with creative and customer engagement teams to improve messaging, landing pages, conversion quality, and monetization throughout the funnel - Monitor advertising profitability, investigate performance discrepancies, and continuously refine acquisition strategies based on revenue and customer behavior - Work directly with the founder on acquisition priorities, performance reviews, and growth opportunities, with the potential to mentor and lead junior media buyers as the function expands Requirements - 4+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or media buying, including substantial exposure to such advertising verticals as adult or dating - Proven track record of personally managing monthly advertising budgets of $100,000 or more on Meta within adult, dating, nutra, or gambling verticals, including successfully scaling at least one offer from initial testing to this spending level - Advanced expertise in Meta Ads, covering campaign structure, creative testing, budget allocation, optimization, and scaling strategies - Practical experience with Google Ads and at least one native or adult advertising network, with an understanding of how acquisition approaches differ between traffic sources - Strong knowledge of performance marketing economics, including acquisition costs, first-purchase conversion, payback periods, customer value, and revenue-based campaign evaluation - Experience maintaining advertising account stability in policy-sensitive industries, including account preparation, gradual scaling, appeals, and legitimate recovery from suspensions - Ability to design and execute systematic creative testing strategies, make data-backed scaling decisions, and discontinue underperforming campaigns efficiently - Hands-on experience configuring tracking platforms such as Keitaro, Voluum, RedTrack, or similar, including server-side conversion tracking, postbacks, and attribution troubleshooting - Strong analytical skills, commercial judgment, and the ability to independently manage substantial budgets and campaign performance - Ability to demonstrate previous campaign results and personally managed advertising accounts or dashboards during the assessment process, with sensitive information anonymized where necessary - Upper-intermediate or higher level of English for business communication and daily work What's in it for you - Fully remote work with the flexibility to work from any time zone - Competitive senior-level base salary - Direct collaboration with the founder and significant influence over paid acquisition strategy and commercial results - Opportunity to build and develop the media buying function, with potential to take on team leadership responsibilities as the business grows - A dynamic environment with opportunities for professional development and long-term growth

items.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager, Korea
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Partnerships team builds relationships that expand the reach of our products, make them more useful and accelerate adoption around the world. The Strategic Partnerships Manager will grow the impact of OpenAI’s strategic partnerships in Korea, expanding adoption, deepening engagement and making our products more useful to local users. You will own a portfolio of partnerships from onboarding and launch through ongoing performance, renewal and expansion, turning partner commitments into measurable results for OpenAI and its partners. About the Role Your portfolio will span distribution partnerships, product integrations, local search and location-data collaborations, and joint marketing programs with Korean consumer platforms and ecosystem partners, including messaging and super-apps. As the primary relationship owner, you will build trust with partner executives and working teams, set joint business plans, and identify opportunities to strengthen and expand each partnership. You will work with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, Korea GTM, Legal and Policy to translate partner and user needs into action, resolve delivery challenges and improve performance. You will also coordinate device and other global partner opportunities with the relevant account teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines commercial and product judgment with disciplined execution. items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is growing fast, and user acquisition is one of the most important levers we have. This role leads the team responsible for bringing new users onto the platform through paid and owned channels, from search and social to influencer partnerships and beyond. You'll manage a small but growing team of channel specialists and work closely with product, data, and brand to build acquisition programs that actually scale. The mandate is straightforward: grow the number of people who sign up, deposit, and trade on Polymarket. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. items.title: Mobile User Acquisition Manager
items.description: ABOUT MEDIALICIOUS At Medialicious, we're a global growth marketing partner powering the expansion of fast-growing social gaming brands. Headquartered in Gibraltar, our mission is simple: to be the industry leader through deep domain expertise, constant innovation, and strategic scale. THE ROLE We are looking for a Mobile User Acquisition Manager to own hands-on acquisition performance across our portfolio of skill gaming and social gaming apps. Reporting to the Head of Mobile, you will turn the mobile growth strategy into scaled, profitable install and player acquisition across UA networks and app DSPs You will manage significant budgets, work closely with creative, BI, product and other acquisition teams, and use cohort, LTV and ROAS data to decide where capital goes next. You will bring direct experience acquiring players for skill gaming apps, and the judgement to scale them efficiently. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - You'll plan, launch and optimise app install campaigns across UA networks and app DSPs — AppLovin, Unity Ads, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff and more — chasing quality players, not just cheap installs. - You'll turn the Head of Mobile's growth strategy into real channel plans, budgets and testing roadmaps, and report progress against shared mobile KPIs. - You'll live in the numbers: cohort, LTV, retention and ROAS analysis that tells you exactly when to scale, shift spend or pull the plug. - You'll work with BI and the Head of Mobile on MMP setup, attribution accuracy and incrementality testing, including SKAN and ATT. - You'll brief and iterate with creative on concepts and messaging that actually land with skill gaming audiences. - You'll partner with product, CRO and CRM to lift conversion, activation and retention — and keep every campaign inside platform and regulatory requirements. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience acquiring players for skill gaming apps — this one is non-negotiable. - A strong track record in mobile user acquisition and app performance marketing, scaling gaming apps and managing large media budgets. - Deep hands-on experience with UA networks and app DSPs (AppLovin, Unity Ads, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff). - Confident with AppsFlyer (essential) and similar MMPs and mobile analytics tools. - Sharp analytical skills — cohort, LTV and ROI analysis, and the ability to turn messy data into clear optimisation calls. Incrementality testing and predictive LTV are a big plus. - Clear, direct communicator who works easily across creative, product, BI and analytics, thrives on changing priorities, and holds a degree in Marketing, Business Administration or similar. iGaming or social casino experience welcome. We're small, fast and allergic to bureaucracy. You'll have real ownership from day one, direct access to decision-makers, and the freedom to build something properly good rather than sit in meetings about it. How we work: open communication in Slack (not hidden in DMs), outcomes documented in Monday.com http://Monday.com, deadlines we actually agree and keep, cameras on for calls because we like feeling connected, and communication that says it in 20 words, not 1,000. Our values are simple — PASSION and PERFORMANCE. We love the product, we want to work with the best, we hold each other accountable, we choose progress over perfectionism, and we have a strict no-arsehole policy. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

items.title: Senior Account Executive - Technology
items.location_text: San Francisco, Boston, Seattle, New York
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! SENIOR ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - TECHNOLOGY Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000, large enterprises within the Technology sector. We're looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere's platform can help them achieve their business goals. You'll lay the foundation for Cohere's growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. You'll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. It's a highly self-directed role, so you should be someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you'll help us reach it. As an Account Executive focused on the Technology sector you will: - Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity and relationship building with key stakeholders while also bringing a strong network of key decision-maker and influencer contacts and relationships in the vertical to accelerate engagements, drive strategic partnerships and win sales opportunities - Work closely with customers and prospects as a consultative, trusted advisor who deeply understands their challenges and goals, their technology ecosystem, and will tailor solutions to drive measurable impact for their businesses - Work in close partnership with channel partners to find opportunities to scale outreach and customer satisfaction in your region - Collaborate with product and engineering teams as well as customer success on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach through proof-of-concept, deal close, and deployment; this is not a transactional sale that you can walk away from after the contract is signed but rather requires ongoing oversight of the project to ensure success You may be a good fit if you have: - 8-12+ years of previous B2B sales experience with Global 2000, large enterprises in the Technology sector, negotiating and closing transformational multi-year (2-5 year) SaaS deals in the 7 figure range, and a track record of high performance and exceeding quota - Previous experience as a technical consultative salesperson, selling complex products, such as developer tools, API products, or AI / NLP solutions, are a plus, with a focus on applications in the Financial Services sector - Previous experience working with customers during the deployment phase of the engagement, aligning on how best to configure and customize the solution that supports success in production and builds trust to set up for expansion and growth - Previous experience working with channel partners such as cloud hyperscalers and system integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - High tolerance for ambiguity - as an early sales hire, you'll have to be a self-starter, doer and a strategist who is capable of wearing many hats and doing what it takes to figure out a path to success - Curiosity - you want to go deep on NLP and become an expert on our technology while considering how to fit into a large organization's technology landscape with a focus on its applications in the Financial Services sectors - Fantastic communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others, build strong relationships, can speak to the c-suite, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences in the Financial Services sector Additional Requirements: - Deep understanding of the Technology industry, including key trends, challenges, and opportunities - Ability to articulate the value of AI and NLP solutions in the context of Financial Services operations. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We are looking for an Affiliate Growth Lead, US to build and scale our relationships with finance and investing creators and affiliates across the US market. The role combines business development, creator and affiliate partnerships and performance marketing, with a clear commercial mandate: drive attributable funded accounts and trading volume from active traders and investors, starting with Margin. This is not a crypto-native KOL role. The audience we want to reach already trades and invests, and we reach them through the creators and publishers they trust in traditional finance, trading education and wealth management. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own business development for US finance and investing creators and affiliates, building a high-quality pipeline of trading educators, finance YouTubers and podcasters, newsletter authors, and wealth-management and advisor-creators. - Develop and execute the US creator and affiliate strategy, starting with a focus on driving Margin trading volume and funded accounts, with the scope to expand across Kraken's other trading products. - Own partner acquisition and relationship development, from initial outreach and commercial conversations through activation and ongoing growth. - Structure CPA, revenue-share and hybrid partnerships that tie partner incentives to funded accounts and trading activity. - Set up and manage the tracking, attribution, payout and reporting needed to measure partners through funded and traded accounts. - Work with Legal and Compliance on disclosure, content review and approved messaging, so that promotion of leveraged products is responsible and consistent. - Partner across Growth, Marketing, Product and other relevant teams to turn creator and affiliate opportunities into effective campaigns, and bring partner and audience feedback back into the product. - Coordinate with the NORAM Pro KOL Business Development team so each creator has a single point of contact and relationships are not duplicated. - Track attributable trading volume, funded accounts, active-trader retention and CAC per partner, and use the results to prioritize partners and investment. - Continuously identify emerging creators, communities and affiliate publishers that reach active traders and investors in the US. WHAT YOU BRING - Deep experience in business development, partnerships, influencer management or affiliate-led growth in the US, with a track record of running performance-based creator or affiliate programs for a brokerage, trading platform or investing product. - Experience growing margin, options, futures or other leveraged or active-trading products. - A strong existing network and understanding of the US finance and investing creator ecosystem, including trading educators, finance YouTubers, newsletter authors, podcasters and wealth-management or advisor-creators. - Working knowledge of crypto and digital assets, with the ability to explain crypto trading products clearly to audiences who are new to them. - Demonstrated ability to originate, negotiate and grow commercially meaningful partnerships, including CPA, revenue-share and hybrid deal structures. - Hands-on experience with affiliate networks and tracking platforms. - A record of turning creator or affiliate activity into measurable outcomes such as funded accounts, trading volume, revenue or acquisition, with results you can describe in numbers. - Familiarity with US financial advertising rules, including FTC paid-endorsement disclosure, and experience getting creator content through compliance review. - Strong relationship-building skills, with the credibility to work with creators who protect their audience's trust and are selective about the brands they promote. - Commercial judgment: you prioritize partners based on expected impact on conversion and trading activity, not on reach or activity alone. - Comfort using performance data to evaluate partners, diagnose results, adjust strategy and end partnerships that do not perform. - Strong cross-functional execution skills and the ability to move opportunities from prospecting through launch and ongoing growth. NICE TO HAVES - Experience working in wealth management or fintech. - Experience at a crypto exchange or digital-asset firm. - Existing relationships with US crypto-native creators. items.title: Senior Partnerships Manager (UK)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Join our team of Relationship Managers and become part of an impactful and dynamic environment. Our team plays a central role at Raisin, responsible for fostering partnerships with our platforms’ partner banks. As a Partnership Manager, you'll play a crucial role in driving Raisin's growth across Europe and the UK. Your primary mission is to cultivate and oversee daily interactions with Raisin's partner banks, and to lead or support managing key accounts. Beyond that, you'll spearhead the launch of new products, integration of new banks into Raisin's and our B2B partners' marketplaces, and improving their technical integration with us to ensure scalability and the growth of the banks’ assets under management and ultimately the Raisin platform. With our far-reaching impact and diverse stakeholders, we have a comprehensive view of platform-wide evolutions, and others depend on your ability to communicate these changes and their broader implications. We are ultimately accountable for owning and managing our partner banks, taking direct responsibility for the performance and reporting of those partners and bringing new savings products to the consumer market. To excel in this role, you should be adept at managing senior stakeholders, both internally and externally. We’re a high growth fintech business, so the ability to work on multiple relationships and ad-hoc projects concurrently is key. Your Responsibilities As a Senior Partnership Manager , you will serve as a commercial lead and strategic advisor for our portfolio of partner banks in the UK and Europe. Moving beyond traditional relationship management, this role requires a consultative, balance-sheet-first mindse t to help executive banking leadership solve liquidity, capital, and deposit-funding challenges using Raisin's platform technology. C-Suite Advisory & Partner Ownership: Act as the primary strategic contact for Treasury Heads, Chief Financial Officers, and C-suite banking executives, aligning Raisin's platform capabilities with their balance sheet, liquidity, and cost-of-funding objectives. Commercial Strategy & Portfolio Expansion: Proactively structure, negotiate, and execute commercial growth strategies to scale partner Assets Under Management (AUM) and launch new deposit product lines. Structured Problem-Solving & Execution: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams across internal cross-functional teams (Solutions Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations) to ensure seamless bank onboarding and technical integrations. Strategic Market Expansion: Drive priority commercial initiatives across the UK and EEA markets, identifying opportunities to launch adjacent financial products and expand strategic partner coverage. What Success Looks Like: Executive Positioning: Establish yourself as a trusted commercial advisor to executive leadership across your assigned bank portfolio. AUM & Portfolio Growth: Deliver measurable deposit growth by optimizing bank partner pricing, funding targets, and market positioning. Flawless Program Execution: Successfully lead complex bank integration and product launch milestones on schedule. Your Profile Education: Top-tier Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative discipline. Professional Background: 3–6+ years of experience in Management Consulting or Investment Banking (FIG background) or Strategic Partnerships within a B2B Fintech/BaaS scale-up. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Strong command of bank balance sheets, deposit mechanics, regulatory frameworks, and commercial deal structuring. Structured Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional capability to translate complex financial and technical concepts into structured executive presentations for bank leaders. Project & Stakeholder Ownership: Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-variable projects autonomously in fast-paced environments. Nice-to-Haves Direct experience with UK/EEA banking regulations (FCA, BaFin), liquidity coverage ratios (LCR), or BaaS/Open Banking infrastructure. Transaction, M&A, treasury, or advisory experience working directly with UK and European retail or commercial banks. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year. Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock. We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office. We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year. One day birthday leave to celebrate your birthday. We offer you a company stakeholder pension with a minimum employer contribution of 5%. The opportunity to experience our annual retreats in exciting European cities and other team building events. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
