We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? items.title: Director, Experiential Partnerships - Fanatics Events
items.description: About Us Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. About Fanatics Events Fanatics Events creates large-scale consumer festivals and live experiences that bring fans, athletes, brands and partners together. Our flagship productions include Fanatics Fest, a multi-day fan festival combining sports, collectibles, athlete appearances, content, and immersive brand experiences; and WWE World, a multi-day consumer event produced in partnership with WWE. As we continue to scale our live events business, we are seeking an Experiential Partnerships Director to lead the development and execution of complex brand partnership programs across Fanatics Events. The Role The Director of Experiential Partnerships is a senior individual contributor responsible for turning ambitious brand partnership ideas into exceptional, executable fan experiences. The role owns major partner programs from early-stage concept development through onsite execution, working across partnerships, creative and operational teams to shape solutions, support new business development, pressure-test feasibility and lead delivery once sold. The ideal candidate has personally led complex experiential programs for brands at major tentpole events and combines strategic thinking with the operator judgment to anticipate challenges, mobilize teams and move programs from idea to execution. What You'll Do Shape & Sell the Solution Support the development of pitch materials and partnership proposals, helping translate experiential concepts into clear, compelling client-facing recommendations. Lead and support partner pitches, bringing an experiential and operational point of view to new business conversations. Pressure-test concepts for feasibility, cost, timing, dependencies, and execution risk before commitments are made. Support management of the pipeline, including opportunity tracking, revenue forecasting, budgets, and financial projections. Engage the appropriate internal teams early to ensure partnership solutions are both ambitious and executable. Own the Program Own assigned partnerships from kickoff through onsite execution and post-event wrap. Translate commercial commitments and creative concepts into clear work-streams, timelines, budgets, and decision points. Drive execution across Creative, Operations, Production, Talent, Marketing, Media, Legal, Finance, agencies, and vendors. Maintain command of the overall program while holding functional experts accountable for their respective workstreams. Oversee Delivery Anticipate operational challenges and dependencies before they become critical issues. Bring clear recommendations and solutions when navigating ambiguity or changing circumstances. Maintain financial discipline across assigned programs, identifying potential scope or budget exposure early. In collaboration with Operations, manage assigned partner programs onsite, making timely decisions and resolving issues in a fast-moving live environment. Lead the Partner & Operation Serve as the primary day-to-day lead for assigned brand partners and their agencies. Set clear expectations around scope, timelines, responsibilities, and decision-making. Navigate evolving partner requests while protecting program feasibility, economics, and the overall fan experience. Build trusted relationships across partner organizations and effectively engage senior Fanatics leadership when appropriate. What We're Looking For 8–12 years of experience in experiential marketing, integrated brand experiences, live events, sponsorship activation, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience personally leading complex experiential programs from concept development through onsite execution. Experience delivering major tentpole events and programs for blue-chip brands. Experiential agency experience strongly preferred and will be prioritized . Strong event production fluency and an understanding of how creative concepts translate into operational and financial requirements. Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or incomplete information and turn it into a clear recommendation and actionable plan. Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional teams, agencies, and vendors without direct reporting authority. Strong client-facing communication skills, financial discipline and comfort operating independently in fast-moving environments. Willingness to travel and work onsite during major event weeks, including weekends as needed. What Success Looks Like Partnership concepts add value to the fan experience, are operationally feasible, and appropriately scoped before going to market. Partner programs move from concept through execution with clear ownership, strong financial discipline, and minimal late-stage surprises. Programs are delivered on time, on budget and at the quality expected by Fanatics and its partners. Partners and internal teams view you as a trusted leader who can turn ambitious ideas into exceptional live experiences. The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ Salary Range $145,000 — $160,000 USD By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

items.title: Senior Account Executive, Audience & Curation
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com THE ROLE: The Brands & Agencies organization is run as five pods, one per buyer group. Your pod, WPP , Publicis, or Omnicom is led by a VP and staffed with account executives who own the client and planning relationships. You're the technical specialist in that pod: you own the two layers the rest of the team supports but doesn't run, your H oldco's data organization and its trading desk. This is a specialist individual-contributor role, not a junior one. You’ll carry your own curation and audience revenue number, and you will be the most technical person in the room on most calls, including calls where your VP is the senior relationship owner and you are there because the questions have gotten specific. This is a heavy, hands-on sales role. You will live inside your assigned Holdco's trading desk and data organization. Working directly with trading and buying teams, and building relationships across investment, curation, and programmatic teams, to personally lead deals end-to-end. You'll work side-by-side with Ad Operations, Product, and our Insights team to translate our audience products into the solutions those buying teams need. What You'll Do Carry the curation and audience number Own and exceed an individual quota for curated-deal and audience revenue within your assigned holdco. Source, lead, and close curated deal and segment agreements with your Holdco's trading, curation, and data teams, from first conversation through commercial terms, taxonomy sign-off, and activation. Keep pipeline and forecast accurate in CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), and know the difference between a deal that is signed and a deal that is actually spending. Report on what is live and what is stuck: deals activated, segments distributed, spend flowing through curated packages, and the specific blocker on anything that has stalled. Own the trading desk relationship Get Genius curated deal IDs and PMPs into the packages your holdco's central trading and curation unit buys from, and into the agency-level programmatic teams that draw on them. Work fluently in the platforms these teams live in: The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP, and the major SSP and curation platforms, plus your Holdco's own proprietary planning and activation stack. Negotiate deal structure the way trading teams think about it; floor pricing, fees and take rates, scale and match-rate guarantees, tiering, and reporting SLAs and know when a curated deal is the right vehicle versus a segment license. Solve the unglamorous problems that decide whether a deal scales: deal-ID hygiene, throughput and win rates, discrepancy resolution, and the reasons a curated package underdelivers. This is a large part of the job and the part that most often decides whether a test renews. Own the data and audience relationship Get Genius segments distributed, priced, and discoverable everywhere your holdco's data teams shop: DSP data marketplaces, LiveRamp, Snowflake and other data-collaboration environments, and identity frameworks including UID2 and RampID. Map Genius audiences into your holdco's proprietary taxonomy and audience framework so a planner finds them where they already look, under names they already use. Partner with your holdco's analytics and data-science teams on clean-room work, modeling, incrementality design, and the measurement standards they use to grade audience performance. Own the answers to the five questions every data buyer asks: scale, match rate, freshness, how the audience was constructed, and proof it drove something. Make the rest of the pod dangerous Be the technical escalation for your VP and account executives. The person they pull into a call when the questions get specific, and who they can send in alone when they cannot make it. Turn what you learn at the desk and the data team into enablement the pod can use: how our audiences are built, what they cost, what they beat, and which objections have already been answered. Feed deal-level friction back to Product and Data Engineering; new audiences, refresh cadence, scale and match rates, and the gaps that keep costing deals at your holdco. Work with Ad Ops, Insights, and Marketing on case studies, benchmark reporting, and the post-campaign proof that turns a test into a renewed commitment. Share pricing precedent, objection patterns, and winning structures with the Curation & Audience Leads in the other Holdco pods, what one of you proves should shorten the path for the others. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 4-6 years in programmatic, curation, audience data, or agency trading on the sell side, at an agency desk, or at a platform, with at least some time spent responsible for revenue rather than only for execution. Hands-on fluency in the audience supply chain: deal IDs and curation, DSP and SSP mechanics, data marketplaces and onboarding, identity and match rates, clean rooms, and CPM-versus-data-fee economics. You should be able to diagnose why a deal is not spending without asking anyone. Direct experience working with or inside a major HoldCo (WPP, Publicis, or Omnicom) you know its stack, its taxonomy, and roughly how a new data partner gets approved. Working relationships at a major holdco's trading, curation, or data teams, or a demonstrable ability to build them quickly at that layer. Ability to sell a data product on its merits to buyers who will pressure-test every claim, and to hold your own in a technical conversation with an analytics lead. Comfort making complex things simple: you can explain moment-based audience construction to a trading lead who has 11 other meetings that day, without either oversimplifying or losing them. Operating discipline: accurate forecasting, clean CRM hygiene (HubSpot or Salesforce), and reliable follow-through on the operational detail that makes deals actually spend. IT WILL BE A BONUS IF YOU: Spent time at an agency trading desk, curation platform, SSP, DSP, data provider, or identity company. Background in sports media, sports data, or fan-engagement products. Familiarity with clean-room and data-collaboration environments (Snowflake, LiveRamp, InfoSum, Amazon Marketing Cloud) and with attention or outcomes-based measurement. Experience as the technical specialist inside a pod or account team, supporting sellers who own the senior relationships. Ad ops or campaign management experience, the instinct for why a campaign underdelivers is hard to teach and valuable here. This role offers an annualized salary of $130,000 - $150,000, plus variable compensation, and includes eligibility for Genius Sports Group’s benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.title: Senior Account Executive - Montreal/Atlantic Canada
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000, large enterprises within Eastern Canada. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. You’ll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. It’s a highly self-directed role, so you should be someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you’ll help us reach it. As an Account Executive you will: - Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity and relationship building with key stakeholders while also bringing a strong network of key decision-maker and influencer contacts to drive strategic partnerships and win sales opportunities - Work closely with customers and prospects as a consultative, trusted advisor who deeply understands their challenges and goals, their technology ecosystem, and will tailor solutions to drive measurable impact for their businesses - Work in close partnership with channel partners to find opportunities to scale outreach and customer satisfaction in your region - Collaborate with product and engineering teams as well as customer success on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach through proof-of-concept, deal close, and deployment ; this is not a transactional sale that you can walk away from after the contract is signed but rather requires ongoing oversight of the project to ensure success You may be a good fit if you have: - 8-12+ years of previous B2B sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprises negotiating and closing transformational multi-year (2-5 year) SaaS deals in the 7 figure range, and a track record of high performance and exceeding quota - Previous experience as a technical consultative salesperson, selling complex products, such as developer tools, API products, or AI / NLP solutions, are a plus. - Previous experience working with customers during the deployment phase of the engagement, aligning on how best to configure and customize the solution that supports success in production and builds trust to set up for expansion and growth - Previous experience working with channel partners such as cloud hyperscalers and system integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - High tolerance for ambiguity - as an early sales hire, you’ll have to be a self-starter, doer and a strategist who is capable of wearing many hats and doing what it takes to figure out a path to success - Curiosity - you want to go deep on NLP and become an expert on our technology while considering how to fit into a large organization’s technology landscape - Fantastic communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others, build strong relationships, can speak to the c-suite, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences Additional Requirements: - Deep understanding of the enterprise landscape, including key trends, challenges, and opportunities - Ability to articulate the value of AI and NLP solutions in the context of Fortune 2000 operations. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Integrity Sales & Partnerships Lead
items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Integrity Sales & Partnerships Lead reports to the VP, Integrity Services and serves as a member of the Integrity Services global Sales & Partnerships team. The role combines business development, strategic account management, commercial planning, and regional sales operations responsibilities to drive sustainable revenue growth across the Integrity Services portfolio. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and converting new business opportunities, expanding strategic client relationships, and supporting the execution of the global product-led commercial strategy. Working closely with product owners, operational teams, and other Sportradar business units, the individual will act as a trusted advisor to sporting organisations while contributing directly to regional and global revenue objectives. This position requires a commercially minded and results-oriented professional with strong business acumen, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to balance independent ownership of opportunities with collaborative execution across a global team. THE CHALLENGE Act as a member of the global commercial team, driving new business acquisition, account expansion, and cross-sell opportunities across the full Integrity Services portfolio, including Anti-Match-Fixing, Integrity Education, Due Diligence, Athlete Protection, Anti-Doping, and other Integrity Services solutions. Identify, evaluate, and advance commercial opportunities across sporting entities, including international federations, national federations, leagues, clubs, event organisers, regulators, and other key stakeholders. Own individual revenue, pipeline, and business development targets, contributing directly to regional and global Integrity Services growth objectives. Develop and execute strategic account plans for priority clients, identifying opportunities for contract renewals, service expansion, and long-term partnership growth. Provide exceptional account management and customer care, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across the sports ecosystem. Collaborate closely with global product owners and commercial colleagues to identify, develop, and progress opportunities across the Integrity Services portfolio. Actively contribute market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insights to support product development, commercial strategy, and go-to-market planning. Represent Sportradar Integrity Services at industry conferences, forums, workshops, and stakeholder events. Work closely with other Sportradar business units to identify joint opportunities, support strategic pursuits, and maximise the value of existing client relationships. Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, contract, and forecasting data within Salesforce, ensuring transparency and consistency across the sales cycle. Support commercial planning and regional forecasting through the preparation of revenue reports, pipeline analysis, business reviews, and market assessments. Contribute to the development of regional market intelligence, identifying emerging trends, governance developments, regulatory changes, competitive dynamics, and growth opportunities. Develop and maintain expert knowledge of the Integrity Services portfolio, products, and market positioning, acting as a trusted internal and external subject matter expert. Drive operational excellence and regional efficiency through disciplined Salesforce utilisation, commercial reporting, pricing consistency, and contract management processes. ABOUT YOU Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sports Management, International Relations, Law, Finance, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in sports business, sports technology, integrity, governance, betting, consulting, or a related commercial environment. Demonstrated success in business development, account management, partnership management, and revenue generation. Strong understanding of the sports ecosystem, including sporting federations, leagues, clubs, governing bodies, regulators, and commercial stakeholders. Proven ability to develop senior stakeholder relationships and navigate complex sales environments. Experience working in an international business environment, collaborating effectively across functions, regions, and product teams. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and commercial reporting. Advanced experience using Salesforce and other CRM platforms to manage opportunities, forecasting, account planning, and sales performance. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable operating independently while contributing to a collaborative global team environment. Passionate about sport, integrity, governance, and the role technology can play in protecting and enhancing sport. Willingness to travel regularly throughout the region and internationally when required. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two Hiring Team Interviews : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Onsite Interview (If not organized on prior interview stages): Meet with the local team and take a tour of our office for a final meet-and-greet. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! Pay Range: $117,000 - $155,000 Sportradar intends to offer the selected candidate base pay within this range, dependent on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications, and location. Base pay is just one component of the Total Rewards that Sportradar provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. items.title: Head of Business Development – Sportsbook, LATAM
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com The Role - Head of Business Development Manager – Sportsbook, LATAM We’re seeking an exceptional Head of Business Development to drive new commercial opportunities across the sportsbook and betting sectors in Latin America. This is a high-impact revenue-driving role for someone who thrives on closing deals, hitting ambitious targets, and building solution-oriented partnerships. You’ll be responsible for identifying new prospects, understanding their business challenges, and matching Genius Sports’ products and services to deliver value. While he/she will be an individual contributor in the near term, the ideal candidate will be expected to manage and lead a team of business development professionals over the long term. The ideal candidate is experienced, strategic and adept at dealmaking. This is someone who has a robust existing network, can open new doors, and close six and seven-figure deals. You’ll be comfortable working independently, while also collaborating closely with internal teams to deliver winning solutions for our betting partners. While you don’t need a technical background, you must have a strong understanding of the betting ecosystem, be able to quickly understand our products, and communicate their value confidently to senior decision-makers in the Latin American betting market. This role requires you to immerse yourself in the betting industry, stay on top of market developments, and represent Genius Sports with energy and credibility at conferences, meetings, and industry events across Latin America. If you’re passionate about being a commercial leader, love sports, and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, this role is for you. What You’ll Bring Proven success in B2B consultative sales, with a strong track record of consistently hitting or exceeding challenging revenue targets Existing experience within the Betting industry or selling to Betting clients in LATAM Fluency in both Spanish & English languages; Portuguese fluency is a bonus Experience closing six-figure (or higher) deals on a consistent basis A results-oriented mindset with high-energy and positive attitude A competitive spirit, resilience and a deep motivation to win Strong commercial creativity and deal-making skills, with the ability to structure and close complex partnerships Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence engaging with and presenting to C-suite executives Solid numerical, analytical, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail A collaborative team player who enjoys working with like-minded, sports-obsessed colleagues A genuine interest in sports and a desire to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven company Willingness and ability to travel within Latin America, attend conferences and events, and meet customers face-to-face to close deals We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. Occasional travel may be required. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. We’re upfront about where we use AI in our hiring process. Our guidelines cover our approach to the use of AI, as well as what you can expect during the interview process. Read our full guidelines here . One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. items.title: Senior Account Executive
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000 across Sweden, Denmark and Norway in telecommunications, financial services, industrial manufacturing, energy and utilities, and healthcare and life sciences. Sovereignty and control over where data and models reside are growing priorities across these sectors, and Cohere is well positioned to meet that need with private, on-premise and in-country deployment built for enterprise scale. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. As a Senior Account Executive, you will: - Drive net-new customer acquisition across Sweden, Denmark and Norway via targeted outbound activity, executive introductions, and relationship building with key stakeholders - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach, technical and business validation, through deal close - Support coverage of adjacent Nordic accounts as territory priorities require - Generate and own your own pipeline through disciplined outbound, research and executive prospecting - Be a trusted advisor to customer prospects, deeply understand their challenges & goals, and tailor solutions to drive impact for their businesses - Leverage senior-level relationships with executives to drive strategic partnerships and sales opportunities - Align closely with our partners and systems integrators to drive shared revenue and extend reach into target accounts - Work cross-functionally across the business, drawing in the right technical and specialist colleagues as each engagement requires - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives and Marketing to supplement your own top of funnel activity You may be a good fit if you have: - Fluent in at least one Nordic language – Swedish, Norwegian or Danish – in addition to English; additional Nordic languages are a strong advantage - 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprise customers along with experience negotiating & closing transformational 7-figure deals - Depth in at least two of our priority sectors: financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences - A hunter mentality - you take pride in generating your own pipeline and are at your best when building a territory rather than managing an inherited one - A proven track record of high performance and exceeding quotas - Experience building and maintaining senior-level relationships with executives - Experience working alongside channel partners and systems integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - Excellent communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others & building strong relationships, experienced presenting to a C-suite audience, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical customer prospects Additional Requirements: - Experience selling complex enterprise level solutions, technical products, and private or on-premise deployments (AI/NLP solutions preferred) - Familiarity with European data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements as live buying criteria - High tolerance for ambiguity - this is an early-stage territory without an established local playbook, and you'll need to be both a doer and a strategist - Creativity - deal structures can widely vary, strong technical acumen and the ability to creatively structure mutually beneficial partnerships are necessary FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: SMB Innovation Sales & Strategy Lead
items.description: About the Team OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways. The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth. About the Role The SMB Innovation Sales & Strategy Lead will identify, incubate and scale new revenue opportunities across OpenAI’s SMB Ads business. This foundational role combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor and hands-on execution to develop differentiated customer propositions, validate product opportunities and launch new go-to-market programs. Working across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Data Science, this person will lead initiatives from opportunity assessment through customer discovery, commercial pilots and transition to scale. The remit includes industry-specific opportunities, differentiated customer engagement models and innovative approaches across self-serve, sales-assisted and partner-led channels. The lead will also partner with SMB leadership and the Strategy & Operations team to inform the overall SMB strategy, contributing customer segmentation, commercial insights and evidence from incubation programs to broader planning and investment decisions. In This Role, You Will - Identify untapped opportunities across SMB segments, industries, and channels. Build business cases and launch pilots to validate customer demand and commercial potential. - Design new acquisition, activation, and expansion programs, including industry-specific and assisted-growth approaches. Partner with sales teams and outsourced sales providers to connect self-serve adoption with sales-assisted engagement. - Translate customer discovery into product opportunities. Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate solutions and use customer and commercial evidence to guide investment. - Develop actionable SMB segmentation based on needs, business characteristics, advertising maturity, behavior, growth potential, and economics. Tailor acquisition, onboarding, service, and expansion across customer channels. - Own pilot delivery and measurement across incremental revenue, conversion, customer outcomes, and cost to serve. Scale successful programs through clear playbooks and ownership; refine or retire those that miss defined success criteria. - Shape SMB strategy and investment recommendations with leadership and Strategy & Operations, drawing on market analysis, segmentation, and pilot results. - Lead the innovation portfolio through clear roadmaps, performance measures, and decision milestones. Resolve delivery challenges and transition proven programs into ongoing operations. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Bring approximately 8-10 years of experience in business incubation, growth, strategy, business operations, product strategy, or consulting, with substantial ownership of implementation and commercial results. - Understand SMB customers and self-serve business models, including how sales-assisted and partner-led approaches support growth. - Demonstrate success taking initiatives from customer insight and business case through pilot, launch, and measurable impact. - Apply strong analytical and financial modeling skills across opportunity sizing, unit economics, funnel analysis, and experimentation. - Translate customer segmentation into differentiated propositions, engagement models, and investment decisions. - Work directly with customers to uncover needs and shape product and go-to-market recommendations. - Lead cross-functional initiatives, align senior stakeholders, and resolve competing priorities. - Combine strategic analysis with hands-on customer discovery, pilot delivery, and program execution. - Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments and move effectively across complex organizations. Preferred Experience - Bring experience in advertising platforms, marketplaces, or SMB technology businesses. - Combine management consulting experience with substantial hands-on operating responsibility. - Draw on experience in both established technology companies and startups. - Build on experience with outsourced sales channels, sales-assisted growth, or industry-specific commercial programs. Workplace & Location - San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Partnerships Operations Lead, OAI for Government
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government helps public-sector institutions use advanced AI responsibly to improve services and advance critical missions. The Partnerships team builds the external ecosystem and internal operating mechanisms required to deliver that work at scale. Role Summary We are seeking a Partnerships Operations Lead to build and run the operating foundation for OpenAI for Government’s Partnerships team. This person will serve as the operational connective tissue across the partner team, working closely with Account Directors, Solutions Architects, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and other cross-functional stakeholders to move opportunities from initial engagement through agreement and execution. They will help ensure a smooth handoff to Technical Success across accounts by establishing clear readiness criteria, capturing the right commercial and customer context, and aligning teams on partner roles, commitments, dependencies, and success outcomes. The ideal candidate is a true utility player who combines the relationship instincts of a growth oriented builder with the rigor of an exceptional business operator. They thrive in ambiguity, create processes that do not yet exist, and move fluidly between deal execution, workflow design, analysis, and cross-functional coordination. Key Responsibilities - Own the end-to-end operating cadence for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities, from intake and qualification through approvals, contracting, launch, and expansion. - Build and continuously improve operating processes, standard procedures, stage gates, decision rights, and service expectations that make partner execution faster and more predictable. - Operationalize new and existing government partner motions—including cloud providers, resellers, and sell-through models—by translating requirements that differ from standard commercial motions into clear workflows, enablement, decision rights, and cross-functional handoffs. - Coordinate deal execution across Account Directors, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, Security and Compliance, Product, Technical Success, and partner teams, ensuring every action has a clear owner and timeline. - Establish a consistent handoff from commercial teams to Technical Success by standardizing readiness criteria, account context, use cases, partner responsibilities, commitments, dependencies, and success plans. - Unblock complex deals by surfacing issues early, driving approvals and escalations, managing exceptions, and closing gaps between functions. - Maintain the operational source of truth for contract milestones, partner launches, handoff readiness, dependencies, and risks, with a high bar for process and data quality; coordinate with Revenue Operations to ensure partner context is reflected in pipeline and CRM data. - Own the government-partner operating cadences for deal execution, launch tracking, and business reviews; coordinate with Revenue Operations on pipeline and forecasting inputs and turn the resulting data into concise insights and actions. - Identify and implement workflow, tooling, and automation improvements that reduce cycle time, eliminate recurring friction, and enable the partner team to scale. Qualifications - 7+ years of experience in operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, go-to-market business operations, or complex program management. - A track record of building operating processes and cross-functional workflows from the ground up in a fast-moving organization. - Experience supporting the end-to-end deal lifecycle in enterprise technology, public sector, or another complex and regulated environment. - Exceptional program-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple high-priority workstreams, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines. - Strong systems and data orientation, including experience with CRM, reporting, workflow, and collaboration tools. - Ability to move between detailed execution and systems-level problem solving without losing speed, accuracy, or accountability. - Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority. items.title: Senior Account Executive - US Public Sector (Civilian and Federal)
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Senior Account Executive, Federal Civilian (US) Why this role? As a Senior Account Executive at Cohere you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals, with Federal Civilian Departments and Agencies in the United States. In this role you will be focussed on business development activity within the non-defense Cabinet Level Agencies in the United States, including Department of Veterans Affairs, State Department, and Treasury among others. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with public sector customers to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them drive better citizen outcomes. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across Customer Success, Sales Development, Marketing, and Sales Engineering. You’ll be the voice of the field and help our Product and Engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. In this highly self-directed role, you will thrive in a quickly evolving environment. As a Senior Account Executive, you will: - Drive net-new customer acquisition through targeted outbound activity, senior leader engagement, and relationship building across US Federal Civilian organizations. - Develop and execute a sales plan for the 14 non-defense Cabinet level agencies in the United States. - Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to public sector customers and prospects by understanding their goals and shaping AI solutions that deliver measurable value - Work closely with channel partners, particularly Distributors and VARs as well as major system integrators to scale outreach, accelerate adoption, and maximize customer success - Leverage senior-level relationships with executives and government decision-makers to drive strategic opportunities and long-term partnerships - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams on strategic efforts to deliver enterprise and public-sector solutions - Partner with SDRs and Marketing to drive top-of-funnel activity and overall territory growth - Own the full sales cycle; including discovery, technical and business validation, proof-of-concept, procurement, and deal close within a team-selling environment You may be a good fit if you have: - 10+ years of direct public sector sales experience in the US Federal Government, with a proven track record of closing $5M+ annual quotas. - Deep knowledge of federal procurement cycles and decision-making processes, how to work with resellers, VARs and distributors. - Established network in the D.C. metro area, including federal agencies, prime contractors, and industry associations. - Experience selling SaaS, AI/ML, or enterprise software solutions to government clients. - High tolerance for ambiguity, you are both a strategist and a hands-on operator capable of building a market from the ground up - Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple internal and external stakeholders across fast-moving deals - Creativity and strong technical acumen to structure unique, mutually beneficial partnerships - Excellent communication skills, you listen deeply, understand what matters to senior decision-makers, and confidently present to both technical and non-technical audiences - Must be based in Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia with willingness to travel (25-35%). Cohere is committed to fair and transparent pay practices. The salary range listed for this role reflects the expected base compensation. Actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . We're hiring a Senior Associate to join the Business Development team. This team is responsible for sourcing, executing, and scaling critical partnerships across Coinbase's core products, business lines, and global ecosystem. You'll autonomously own a portfolio of high-impact partner relationships, lead complex deal execution from first conversation through launch, and work directly with product and business leaders to bring new partnerships to life as company priorities and market opportunities evolve. Source, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements, independently managing the full deal lifecycle from initial outreach through close. items.title: Sales Director, Enterprise
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is the world's most trusted digital asset infrastructure company, empowering organizations of all sizes to build, manage and grow their business on the blockchain. With the industry's most scalable and secure platform, we streamline stablecoin payments, settlement, custody, tokenization, trading, accounting operations, and compliance reporting — enabling everything from institutional finance to consumer-facing digital experiences across the largest ecosystem of banks, payment providers, stablecoin issuers, exchanges and custodians. Thousands of organizations - including Worldpay, BNY, Galaxy, and Revolut - trust Fireblocks to secure more than $14 trillion in digital asset transactions across 150+ blockchains. Learn more at fireblocks.com . Here's the bit about the opportunity: As part of the Fireblocks' US sales team, you will play a meaningful role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the Blockchain and Cybersecurity field. You'll own a book of enterprise accounts across the US, working closely with Sales Engineers and Business Leaders to drive complex, high value deals. You'll be: Consistently achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets Selling multiple product lines into large enterprise organizations across industries Working closely with Fireblocks BDRs, Business Solutions and GTM Team Building and maintaining relationships with prospects and customers Prospecting, territory, and account planning Updating and maintaining the Fireblocks CRM Requirements: Experience selling complex technology solutions to enterprise line-of-business executives 8+ years of enterprise SaaS or platform sales experience, with a track record selling into large, complex organizations Strong technical baseline understanding of modern SaaS application architectures, including APIs, and distributed applications Proven track record of selling into CIO, CTO, architecture, and platform engineering and shared services teams Working knowledge of enterprise technology infrastructure, security, compliance, or platform operations Ability to co-sell and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles alongside core account teams A proven record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in highly competitive markets Ability to translate complex technical platform capabilities into tangible business value for both executives and developers We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for A players who want to work with the best. Track record of success and closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sectors. For employees hired to work remotely from New York, or from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role.This range is specific to New York City, and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $128,000 to $170,000 . ($256,000 - $340,000 OTE) The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. items.title: Growth Marketing Lead, EMEA
items.description: About the Team The EMEA Growth Marketing role partners with regional leadership, central Marketing functions and Product Growth to help more people discover ChatGPT, find value and keep coming back. We combine local market insight, paid marketing and creative experimentation to build campaigns that resonate across EMEA’s diverse audiences. Our approach is hands-on and data-driven, with a focus on testing, learning and scaling what delivers meaningful growth and lasting value for users. About the Role We are looking for a Growth Marketing Lead, EMEA to help more people discover ChatGPT, find value and keep coming back. You will own paid marketing across all of our key performance channels and support in our broader full-funnel media buying endeavors. You bring deep paid-marketing experience, credible EMEA knowledge and the range to build a broader marketing function in-time. The role begins as a senior individual contributor, though we expect with the pace of growth you will quickly need to build a team. We are a team of ‘doers’ and everyone starts out this way at Open AI. In this role, you will: - Prioritise EMEA markets and stay close to campaign setup, channel performance, creative testing and paid-media investment decisions. - Help develop local creative briefs and creator inputs for paid growth, with an eye towards brand-building performance. - Connect marketing activity to incremental weekly active users (iWAU) and incremental annual recurring revenue (iARR), with targets aligned with Finance and relevant Growth owners. - Work with regional and central partners on delivery handoffs and shared services. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have personally owned large paid-media budgets and campaign decisions, and driven measurable growth in a fast-moving consumer technology or comparable product-led environment. - Bring meaningful EMEA market knowledge, hands-on operating depth, sound incrementality judgment and the ability to prioritise and execute without a large team. - Want to start as a senior individual contributor and build towards broader regional marketing ownership. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. You will bring Claude to Taiwan’s leading high-tech manufacturers in semiconductors, electronics, and the AI hardware supply chain, helping them apply AI across engineering, operations, supply chain, and corporate functions. items.title: Public Sector Partnerships Lead - France
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives. In this role, you will: Drive government adoption and revenue (primary) - Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products. - Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts. - Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team. Build strategic partnerships (secondary) - Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups. - Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals. Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary) - Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights. - Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy. - Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams. - Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications. - Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives. Who you are: - You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role. - You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products. - You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business. - You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly. - You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward. What you bring: Primary requirements - 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles. - A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong. - Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred. - Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus. Also required - Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights. - Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building. - Public policy experience across France. - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers. - Fluency in English and French. Location This role is located in France. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Manager, Markets Sales on the STP Derivative Sales team, you'll drive Coinbase Advanced's derivatives growth across the UAE, MENA, and Europe by originating and expanding relationships with professional traders. This team owns revenue and market share for Coinbase's derivatives products, including crypto perpetuals, options, and RWA products, across global markets. You'll personally own the client acquisition pipeline for the region, execute the regional sales strategy, and represent Coinbase as a senior market ambassador at events and conferences across some of crypto's fastest-growing markets. What you'll do: Own and grow a network of professional traders across the UAE, MENA, and Europe, driving revenue through high-touch, relationship-led acquisition from origination through onboarding and ongoing account management. Execute the regional sales strategy for the UAE, MENA, and Europe, delivering against targets for market penetration, trading volume growth, and client expansion. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Risk, and Compliance teams to localize perpetual futures, futures, and options products to meet regional compliance requirements and market demands.
