You’ll build and develop a team of Strategic Account Executives who drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with large medical device companies, diagnostics providers, and emerging medtech innovators. You’ll bring deep domain fluency in how medical devices are designed, validated, cleared or approved, manufactured, and monitored in the field to coach your team’s consultative sales approach, while becoming a trusted advisor yourself to senior medtech stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI across the product lifecycle from design and development through post-market surveillance. In collaboration with Product and Marketing, you’ll continuously refine the team’s value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with decision-makers across each medtech sub-segment. The ideal candidate has a passion for developing new market segments within medtech, pinpointing high-potential opportunities across engineering, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, clinical, and commercial functions, and building a team that can execute strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic’s emerging products across medtech organizations, you’ll help them bring safer, better devices to patients faster while advancing the ethical development of AI. Key responsibilities Build and lead a specialized team of Strategic Account Executives covering medical device, diagnostics, and digital health accounts, setting growth targets by sub-segment and coaching reps through the full sales cycle from outbound to close Design and oversee sales strategies tailored to the distinct procurement cycles of medtech, including product development and engineering budgets, quality and regulatory compliance investment, manufacturing and supply chain programs, commercial and field organization budgets, and enterprise IT and digital transformation programs, translating market and trend analysis into account plans and campaigns that meet and exceed team revenue targets Identify and prioritize high-potential opportunities across product design and development, design controls and verification and validation, regulatory affairs and submissions, quality management and CAPA, manufacturing and supply chain, clinical evidence generation, complaint handling and post-market surveillance, and commercial and reimbursement functions, partnering cross-functionally to differentiate Anthropic’s offering for medtech use cases Run a disciplined pipeline and forecasting cadence across the team, managing an evolving sales process to deliver predictable, coachable performance against quota Serve as Anthropic’s domain expert across the medtech value chain, including device design and development, software as a medical device, regulatory submissions (510(k), PMA, De Novo, EU MDR), quality systems, manufacturing, post-market surveillance and vigilance reporting, and commercial launch, and translate that expertise into repeatable playbooks, frameworks, and go-to-market strategies your team and the broader field organization can scale Partner directly with C-suite and senior functional leaders (CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, Chief Quality Officers, CMOs, CCOs, and Heads of R&D, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs) across medtech organizations to design multi-year AI transformation roadmaps and build long-term trusted advisor relationships Partner closely with Product and Applied AI to translate feedback from design engineers, regulatory and quality professionals, manufacturing teams, clinical affairs, and commercial teams into product and roadmap input, strengthening Anthropic’s value proposition across the segment Build strategic relationships with medtech-focused system integrators, technology vendors (including QMS, PLM, and ERP providers), contract manufacturers, and industry organizations to scale go-to-market capabilities Establish Anthropic’s position as the AI partner of choice across medtech through conference presentations, white papers, case studies, and participation in industry forums Codify learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices, partnering with Marketing and Enablement to scale winning use cases and proof points across medtech accounts Minimum qualifications 10+ years of experience in life sciences, with at least 5 years specifically selling into or working within medical device, diagnostics, or medtech organizations (R&D, engineering, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, or commercial functions, or related consulting) Experience in leadership roles managing or coaching enterprise sales teams, with a track record of driving measurable revenue outcomes in medtech or adjacent life sciences settings Deep understanding of medtech business models, operations, and economics, including the device product lifecycle, the regulatory environment (FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR, IEC 62304, 21 CFR Part 11), and competitive dynamics A track record of managing or overseeing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles within medtech organizations, securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and engineering, regulatory, quality, and commercial use cases Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing a team’s pipeline and an evolving sales process Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present confidently across medtech audiences, from design engineers and quality and regulatory leaders to C-suite executives A genuine interest in deploying AI responsibly and motivation to advance Anthropic’s mission of building safe, beneficial AI Preferred qualifications Deep understanding of buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points across multiple medtech sub-segments (e.g., large device manufacturers, diagnostics, digital health and SaMD) and across functions (engineering, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, commercial) A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the medtech market, paired with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities and a willingness to roll up sleeves on deals alongside the team Experience developing and refining AI use cases in collaboration with customers and channel partners, spanning design and development, regulatory and quality documentation, manufacturing, post-market surveillance, or commercial functions Experience building or scaling a specialized sales team from an early stage Passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications in medical devices and diagnostics, with strong conviction around safe, ethical development of AI in these contexts The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $450,000 — $700,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Healthcare: the health systems, hospitals, clinics, health plans, and life sciences companies people trust with their health and their families’ care. These organizations win or lose on trust and access at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to organizations reimagining how they serve patients, members, and clinicians, safely and at scale. In this role you will: - Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the Healthcare industry - Balance a diverse pipeline of large health systems that require a white-glove experience with community hospitals, clinics, and regional providers that require speed to close - Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in patient-facing and internal workflows, such as scheduling and reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, patient intake and outreach, and HCP support - Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in healthcare AI governance - Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (Patient Access and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, IT and Clinical Informatics, and Compliance, Privacy, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across facilities and service lines - Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run, and set them up to scale in production - Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations, including BAAs - Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Healthcare positioning, messaging, and references Requirements - 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms - Healthcare experience (health systems, hospitals, payers, life sciences, health tech) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily - Proven success closing six-and-seven figure deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles - Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close - Experience selling to both technical buyers (IT, product, and engineering) and business buyers (patient access, operations, digital), and to privacy and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value - Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs - Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including HIPAA, BAAs, and PHI data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner - Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences - High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals - Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly - Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Strategic account executive, healthcare & life sciences (UK)
items.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Join WRITER's sales team as a Strategic account executive and help shape the future of work. You'll empower global healthcare and life sciences enterprises (8,000+ employees) to transform their operations through our cutting-edge AI agent platform, enabling organizations to deploy AI at scale and unlock unprecedented productivity. This isn't just about hitting quota – it's about becoming a trusted advisor to some of the world's most influential health plans, health systems, and life sciences companies as they navigate their AI transformation journey. This role is perfect for high performers who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environments where you have the autonomy to drive results and build lasting relationships with both clients and teammates. If you're energized by meaningful work, the opportunity to make a real impact, and the challenge of selling category-defining technology, we want to hear from you. You'll be selling solutions that fundamentally change how healthcare enterprises operate, working with executive buyers who are making multi-million dollar, multi-year commitments to AI transformation. This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub. You'll be reporting to our regional vice president. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you need - 7-10+ years of quota-carrying strategic SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas in complex, value-based sales motions targeting large payer, provider, and life sciences organizations - Deep understanding of the UK and European healthcare and life sciences landscape — payers, providers, pharma, and medtech — including its regulatory environment, buying cycles, and communication standards - Demonstrated expertise in managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement and security processes, and orchestrating cross-functional resources to drive deals through technical evaluations and executive approvals - Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to credibly engage with C-suite buyers (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, COOs), translate complex technical concepts into business value, and build authentic relationships based on trust and strategic insight - Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to conduct discovery that uncovers underlying business challenges, connects AI capabilities to measurable outcomes, and creates urgency around transformation initiatives in highly regulated healthcare environments - Experience in outbound prospecting, account mapping, and territory planning, with a hunter mentality that drives you to consistently create new opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for ownership — you thrive in fast-paced environments where you're expected to figure things out, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive your own success with minimal oversight - Deep alignment with WRITER's values: you naturally Connect across functions and build collaborative relationships, you Challenge the status quo and aren't afraid to have difficult conversations, and you Own your outcomes with accountability and a commitment to long-term impact ⭐️ Is this you? - You've sold into healthcare and life sciences institutions and understand what it takes to navigate complex, regulated buying environments — from security and compliance reviews to board-level approvals - You're a closer who has consistently carried and exceeded seven-figure quotas, and you can point to deals where you created the opportunity from scratch rather than working an inbound lead - You think like a consultant but sell like a hunter — your discovery uncovers pain buyers didn't know they had, and your storytelling connects AI to outcomes that matter to a CIO and a CFO alike - You understand the UK and European healthcare market specifically — the players, the regulators, the buying rhythms — and you have or can build a network that opens doors - You're comfortable in the boardroom and the back office — equally credible presenting an AI transformation vision to an exec team and working through the technical and procurement details with the people who sign off - You move fast, own your number, and don't wait to be told what to do next Preferred skills - Existing network and relationships within UK or European healthcare and life sciences organizations - Background in management consulting, particularly with healthcare or life sciences clients - Experience selling AI, data, or enterprise platform deals into regulated industries - Familiarity with the compliance, security, and governance requirements that shape healthcare buying decisions - Experience supporting or leading large-scale rollouts or change management programs - Strong storytelling and presentation skills for executive audiences 🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees): - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Comprehensive medical and dental insurance - Paid parental leave for all parents (12 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Competitive pension scheme and company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Home office setup, cell phone, internet - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation and company stock options

items.title: Strategic Account Executive - Manufacturing
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000, large enterprises within the Manufacturing sector. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. You’ll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. It’s a highly self-directed role, so you should be someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you’ll help us reach it. As a Strategic Account Executive focused on the Manufacturing industry, you will: - Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity and relationship building with key stakeholders while also bringing a strong network of key decision-maker and influencer contacts and relationships in the Manufacturing industry to accelerate engagements, drive strategic partnerships and win sales opportunities - Work closely with customers and prospects as a consultative, trusted advisor who deeply understands their challenges and goals, their technology ecosystem, and will tailor solutions to drive measurable impact for their businesses - Work in close partnership with channel partners to find opportunities to scale outreach and customer satisfaction in your region - Collaborate with product and engineering teams as well as customer success on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach through proof-of-concept, pilot, deal close, and deployment ; this is not a transactional sale that you can walk away from after the contract is signed but rather requires ongoing oversight of the project to ensure success You may be a good fit if you have: - 8+ years of previous B2B sales experience with Global 2000, large enterprises in the Manufacturing sector, negotiating and closing transformational multi-year (2-5 year) SaaS deals in the 7 figure range, and a track record of high performance and exceeding quota - Previous experience as a technical consultative salesperson, selling complex products, such as developer tools, API products, or AI / NLP solutions, are a plus, with a focus on applications in the Manufacturing sector - Previous experience working with customers during the deployment phase of the engagement, aligning on how best to configure and customize the solution that supports success in production and builds trust to set up for expansion and growth - Previous experience working with channel partners such as cloud hyperscalers and system integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - High tolerance for ambiguity - as an early sales hire, you’ll have to be a self-starter, doer and a strategist who is capable of wearing many hats and doing what it takes to figure out a path to success - Curiosity - you want to go deep on NLP and become an expert on our technology while considering how to fit into a large organization’s technology landscape with a focus on its applications in the Manufacturing sector - Fantastic communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others, build strong relationships, can speak to the c-suite, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences in the Manufacturing sector Additional Requirements: - Deep understanding of the Manufacturing industry, including key trends, challenges, and opportunities - Ability to articulate the value of AI and NLP solutions in the context of Manufacturing operations, such as predictive maintenance, supply chain optimization, and customer engagement - Experience working with regulatory and compliance requirements specific to the Manufacturing industry FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across DACH. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency. You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams. This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound): - Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models - Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships Technical evaluation: - Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear - Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements Deal management and closing: - Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams - Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps Account growth: - Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models - Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production Working with product and science: - Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap - Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: - 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data) - Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders - Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience - Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure - Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract - Excellent English and German - Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Enterprise Account Executive
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Enterprise Account Executive based in Tokyo, you'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI technology across Japan's enterprise market. You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, working with C-level executives at major Japanese corporations to help them transform their businesses with Anthropic's AI solutions. Responsibilities: Own and exceed revenue targets by winning new enterprise accounts and expanding existing relationships across Japan Build and execute territory plans, identifying high-value opportunities in key Japanese industries including financial services, healthcare, technology, and manufacturing Lead consultative sales processes with C-suite and senior technical stakeholders, positioning AI as a strategic business transformation driver Orchestrate internal teams (Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Partnerships) to deliver customized solutions for complex enterprise requirements Identify new use cases and contribute to Japan go-to-market strategy, providing critical feedback to shape product roadmap and regional approach Translate technical AI capabilities into compelling business value propositions tailored to Japanese market needs You may be a good fit if you have: 8+ years of enterprise sales experience in Japan driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach Native-level Japanese fluency and business-level English required A track record of managing complex sales cycles and securing strategic deals in the Japanese market by understanding multifaceted technical requirements and crafting tailored solutions Demonstrated ability to navigate Japanese enterprise stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus through relationship-building and providing innovative solutions to disparate groups Extensive experience negotiating highly complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders in Japanese corporate environments Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced organizations by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process Excellent communication skills in both Japanese and English, with the ability to present confidently and build connections across all customer levels, from individual contributors to C-level executives A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality. You are a true team player who thrives in ambiguous, startup-like environments A strategic, analytical approach to assessing Japanese markets combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities in key industries Deep understanding of Japanese business culture, enterprise buying processes, and regulatory landscape A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely Strong candidates may have: Experience selling emerging technologies (AI/ML, cloud platforms, or data analytics) to Japanese enterprises Established relationships with senior executives at major Japanese corporations Experience navigating Japanese procurement processes and working with system integrators Understanding of AI/ML concepts and ability to discuss technical architectures What We Offer Competitive base salary and commission structure commensurate with experience Equity participation Comprehensive benefits package Hybrid work model with flexibility Opportunity to shape the future of AI adoption in Japan Access to cutting-edge AI technology and world-class research team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Head of Performance Marketing
items.description: About the Team The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative engineering. We blend the best of human ingenuity and creativity, with deep technical and quantitative expertise. About the Role We are hiring a Head of Performance Marketing to lead global paid media and investment allocation across products, audiences, and markets. You will build a global team, partnering closely with product, engineering, data science, and creative to build durable user and revenue growth strategies. Incrementality and marginal returns will guide your investment framework, delivering growth within clear economic guardrails. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will bring expert campaign and measurement judgment while rethinking how performance marketing operates with AI, automation, and agents. You will both need to IC and build a team already operating at massive scale. Working across technical, product, creative, and finance teams, you will build systems that turn experimentation into better execution and sustained growth. In this role, you will: - Set the global performance-marketing strategy and operating model, allocating investment based on incremental impact and marginal returns. - Build and develop a global team with deep channel expertise and clear accountability for results. - Work directly on campaign strategy and execution, diagnosing performance across audiences, creative, bidding, and pacing. - Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Growth Product, and Finance to measure incremental growth, establish economic guardrails, and guide forecasting and investment decisions. - Build AI-powered workflows and agents for creative testing, campaign creation, optimization, and analysis, with rigorous evaluation and human accountability. - Partner with Product Marketing, Creative, and Product to translate audience insights and product priorities into effective campaigns. - Coordinate with the Brand media strategy and planning leader to align execution and share learning across Brand and Growth. You will both need to optimize the ‘overall’ media allocation (i.e. “Brand plus Performance”) intelligently. - Drive the partnership with our biggest ad platform partners (e.g. Google, Meta et al) to stay on the cutting edge of performance, and shape their roadmap to drive innovation. You might thrive in this role if you have: - A track record of scaling performance marketing across channels and markets, delivering incremental user and revenue growth. - Experience building global teams while staying close to campaign execution and technical detail. - Deep paid-media expertise across audience strategy, creative testing, bidding, pacing, and optimization. - Strong judgment in incrementality, experimentation, attribution, and customer economics, with experience translating findings into investment decisions. - Experience personally building or deploying AI workflows and automation, including evaluating results and managing failures. - The technical fluency and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Data Science, Creative, and Finance. - A practical leadership style: you can set long-term direction, investigate problems, and build better ways to work. - Experience managing strategic media-platform partnerships, commercial negotiations, and measurement integrations. - An ability to, and desire to continue to, operate in the fastest moving environment in the world right now.
